change.title: pr-40940-flat
change.description: Fix concurrent group access to prevent NullPointerException
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Reader thread is never joined and is not a daemon
findings.body: The reader thread is started and never joined. `deletedAll.set(true)` is followed at once by the assertion, so an exception thrown by an iteration still running is added to `caughtExceptions` after the assert and goes unnoticed. The thread also keeps running until it sees the flag, so a failure in the deleting loop leaves it spinning, because `deletedAll` is never set. Keep the `Thread`, set the flag in a `finally`, and `join()` it before asserting. There is also a stray whitespace-only line at 117.

contracts.action: GroupAdapter.getSubGroupsCount now reads the delegate via modelSupplier and returns null if the group no longer exists
contracts.equivalent_path: The sibling getSubGroupsStream overloads in the same file call modelSupplier.get() directly (lines 256-268).
contracts.before_after: Before, getGroupModel() was called each time and bypassed the LazyModel cache. Now the lazily cached delegate is reused, and a group deleted concurrently gives null instead of an NPE.
contracts.visible_effect: The admin groups listing with a subgroup count no longer throws when a group is deleted during the read. The count is null for that group.
contracts.failure_mode: The null count goes to GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount, which calls representation.setSubGroupCount(Long). I did not check that the setter accepts a null Long.

summary: The main fix is correct. `getSubGroupsCount` now uses the lazy delegate and tolerates a deleted group. Removing the unused `groupMatchesSearchOrIsPathElement` from `GroupUtils` is safe. The new regression test has one weakness: the reader thread is never joined, so late exceptions can be missed.
